name: What should I do before my bathroom remodel starts?

mainEntity.name: What preparation steps reduce delays and mistakes before construction begins?
mainEntity.text: What preparation steps reduce delays and mistakes before construction begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparation is one of the easiest ways to keep a bathroom remodel on track. Homeowners should finalize layout decisions, pick tile, fixtures, vanity, glass, and lighting before demolition starts, because waiting until mid-project often causes delays. The bathroom and nearby storage areas should be cleared, and anything valuable should be moved out of the work path. It also helps to confirm access, parking, work hours, and where materials will be staged. A homeowner should know how the contractor communicates progress and approves any changes. Good preparation reduces confusion, keeps the budget more stable, and makes the project easier to manage once work is underway.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before construction starts, homeowners should finalize the design, choose all materials, clear the bathroom, confirm the schedule, protect nearby areas, and review how change orders will be handled. The more decisions made upfront, the fewer delays and substitutions happen later.
